##### Project general facts

Presenting Floareá Vista, the newest creation from Mashriq Elite Developments in Discovery Gardens - Al Furjan Community. This architectural gem sets a new standard for living with enchanting interiors, innovative exteriors. Residents are greeted with a stunning array of amenities and features that redefine modern living in Dubai's dynamic landscape.

Each aspect of Floareá Vista is meticulously crafted to offer residents a lifestyle of unparalleled comfort and sophistication. From the moment you step inside, the enchanting interiors captivate the senses, reflecting contemporary elegance and timeless style. The innovative design seamlessly integrates with the surroundings, creating a harmonious living environment that inspires and rejuvenates.

Beyond its captivating aesthetics, Floareá Vista boasts a wealth of amenities designed to enhance every aspect of residents' lives. With its exceptional blend of luxury, convenience, and style, Floareá Vista promises an extraordinary living experience in the heart of Discovery Gardens.

##### Location description and benefits

Discovery Gardens is a residential community located in Jebel Ali, Dubai, known for its affordability and convenient location. Situated in the heart of New Dubai, Discovery Gardens offers easy access to major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Emirates Road, facilitating transportation across the city and beyond. 

One of the notable features of Discovery Gardens is its abundance of greenery and landscaped gardens, providing residents with a tranquil environment and plenty of open spaces for relaxation and leisure activities. Residents also have access to various amenities including swimming pools, playgrounds, and jogging tracks. 

Discovery Gardens is popular among young professionals, families, and expatriates due to its relatively affordable housing options compared to other parts of Dubai. The neighborhood fosters a sense of community with regular events and activities organized for residents, creating a family-friendly environment with dedicated play areas and recreational facilities for children. Overall, Discovery Gardens offers a comfortable and convenient lifestyle with a range of amenities and a welcoming atmosphere for residents.
